basic_info.description: Gorgeous detached corner Art Deco home with sweeping panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and Marin Headlands! Situated directly across from the iconic 16th Avenue mosaic stairway, this exceptional home offers a flexible and functional floor plan ideal for modern living. The top level features two spacious bedrooms, a full bath, and a bright sunroom - perfect as a home office, nursery, or potential third bedroom. A dedicated laundry closet for added convenience! The main level boasts a grand west-facing living room filled with natural light, a formal dining room, an original kitchen, a generously sized breakfast room, and a convenient powder room. On the ground floor, you'll find a large two-car side-by-side garage, ample storage space. Sitting on a sizable 3,800+ sq ft lot (per tax records), the property also includes a spacious backyard - ideal for outdoor entertaining or gardening. Prime location just minutes from public transit, Noriega and Irving Street shops and restaurants, Grandview Park, Golden Gate Park, and UCSF Medical Center. A rare opportunity to own a view home in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods!
